#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run the three approved storage-only Miri checks on an immutable commit."""
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import tarfile
import time

REPO = Path('/Users/lanxingcan/Workspace/zstdoxize')
REV = '6f04a1605d50f3ade59b1c2b5ec6bc283c5e9d08'
SNAPSHOT = Path('/tmp/zstdoxide-module11-storage-platform-6f04a16')
BASE = Path('/tmp/zstdoxide-module11-storage-platform')
EVIDENCE = Path(str(BASE) + '-evidence.json')
MANIFEST = Path(str(BASE) + '-manifest.json')

def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def files(root):
    return {str(p.relative_to(root)): {'bytes': p.stat().st_size,
                                     'sha256': sha(p.read_bytes())}
            for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}

def save(data):
    EVIDENCE.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')

def main():
    if SNAPSHOT.exists():
        raise RuntimeError('Refusing to reuse or overwrite an existing snapshot')
    commit = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', REV], cwd=REPO, text=True).strip()
    if commit != REV:
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected source revision')
    archive = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'archive', '--format=tar', REV], cwd=REPO)
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as tf:
        for member in tf.getmembers():
            path = Path(member.name)
            if path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or not (member.isfile() or member.isdir()):
                raise RuntimeError('Unexpected archive member: ' + member.name)
    SNAPSHOT.mkdir()
    subprocess.run(['tar', '-xf', '-', '-C', str(SNAPSHOT)], input=archive, check=True)
    before = files(SNAPSHOT)
    MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps({'commit': REV, 'snapshot': str(SNAPSHOT), 'files': before}, indent=2) + '\n')
    evidence = {
        'schema': 1, 'scope': 'Exactly three approved Module 11 storage interpretation checks',
        'commit': REV, 'snapshot': str(SNAPSHOT), 'git_archive_sha256': sha(archive),
        'source_manifest': {'path': str(MANIFEST), 'sha256': sha(MANIFEST.read_bytes()), 'file_count': len(before)},
        'qualification': 'Rust MIR interpretation only; i686 is 32-bit little-endian cross-interpretation. No native foreign, QEMU, hardware allocator, maximum-shape, history/API follow-up, or performance claim.',
        'runner': {'path': str(Path(__file__)), 'sha256': sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())},
        'commands': [], 'completed': False,
    }
    common = {'RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN': 'nightly-2026-10-08',
              'MIRIFLAGS': '-Zmiri-strict-provenance', 'CARGO_TERM_COLOR': 'never'}
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.update(common)
    for name, command in [
        ('compiler', ['rustc', '+nightly-2026-10-08', '-vV']),
        ('i686-cfg', ['rustc', '+nightly-2026-10-08', '--print', 'cfg', '--target', 'i686-unknown-linux-gnu']),
    ]:
        data = subprocess.check_output(command, cwd=SNAPSHOT, env=env, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        log = Path(str(BASE) + '-' + name + '.log')
        log.write_bytes(data)
        evidence[name] = {'command': command, 'exit_code': 0, 'log': str(log), 'sha256': sha(data), 'text': data.decode()}
    checks = [
        ('i686-seed-range', 'i686-unknown-linux-gnu', [],
         'encode::tests::search_storage_seed_ranges_preserve_exact_counts_for_wide_and_tiny_shapes'),
        ('host-all-short-dictionary', None, ['--all-features'],
         'encode::tests::search_storage_short_dictionary_replacement_keeps_inactive_seed_layouts_safe'),
        ('host-all-growth-failures', None, ['--all-features'],
         'encode::tests::search_storage_every_growth_failure_preserves_output_and_recovers_with_exact_owners'),
    ]
    save(evidence)
    for name, target, features, selector in checks:
        selected_env = dict(common)
        selected_env['CARGO_TARGET_DIR'] = '/tmp/zstdoxide-module11-storage-miri-' + ('i686' if target else 'host')
        if target:
            selected_env['MIRI_SYSROOT'] = '/tmp/zstdoxide-platform-sysroot-i686'
        run_env = os.environ.copy()
        run_env.pop('MIRI_SYSROOT', None)
        run_env.update(selected_env)
        args = ['--offline', '--locked', '--lib']
        if target:
            args += ['--target', target]
        args += features + [selector, '--', '--exact', '--test-threads=1']
        command = ['python3', 'scripts/check_miri_filter.py', *args]
        log = Path(str(BASE) + '-' + name + '.log')
        print('START ' + name, flush=True)
        started = time.monotonic()
        with log.open('wb') as handle:
            result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=SNAPSHOT, env=run_env, stdout=handle, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
        output = log.read_bytes()
        text = output.decode(errors='replace')
        summaries = [dict(zip(('passed', 'failed', 'ignored', 'measured', 'filtered_out'), map(int, row)))
                     for row in re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored; (\d+) measured; (\d+) filtered out;', text)]
        passed = sum(row['passed'] for row in summaries)
        ignored = sum(row['ignored'] for row in summaries)
        good = result.returncode == 0 and passed == 1 and ignored == 0 and 'Verified 1 passing Miri test(s)' in text
        evidence['commands'].append({'name': name, 'command': command,
            'underlying_command': ['cargo', 'miri', 'test', *args],
            'cwd': str(SNAPSHOT), 'environment': selected_env, 'selector': selector,
            'expected_passed': 1, 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'seconds': round(elapsed, 4),
            'summaries': summaries, 'positive_exact_count_guard': good,
            'log': str(log), 'log_sha256': sha(output), 'log_bytes': len(output)})
        save(evidence)
        print(f'END {name}: exit={result.returncode} passed={passed} guard={good} seconds={elapsed:.2f}', flush=True)
        if not good:
            raise RuntimeError('Miri check or exact-count validation failed: ' + name)
    after = files(SNAPSHOT)
    evidence['source_unchanged'] = after == before
    evidence['changed_files'] = [p for p in sorted(set(before) | set(after)) if before.get(p) != after.get(p)]
    evidence['completed'] = after == before
    evidence['passed'] = sum(sum(s['passed'] for s in c['summaries']) for c in evidence['commands'])
    save(evidence)
    if after != before:
        raise RuntimeError('Archived source changed')
    print('EVIDENCE ' + str(EVIDENCE) + ' sha256=' + sha(EVIDENCE.read_bytes()), flush=True)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Approved bounded history/public Miri and thumb compile-only checkpoint."""
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import tarfile
import time

ROOT=Path('/Users/lanxingcan/Workspace/zstdoxize')
REV='24aff8fad7742fb443ce3c828fd27995e3344bc4'
SNAPSHOT=Path('/tmp/zstdoxide-module11-final-platform-24aff8f')
PROBE=Path('/tmp/zstdoxide-module11-thumb-probe')
PROBE_SOURCE=Path('/tmp/zstdoxide-module11-thumb-probe-source.rs')
BASE='/tmp/zstdoxide-module11-final-platform'
OUT=Path(BASE+'-evidence.json')
MANIFEST=Path(BASE+'-manifest.json')
FEATURES='unsafe-byte-cursor,unsafe-bitstream,unsafe-history,unsafe-ring-history,unsafe-fse,unsafe-fse-encoder,unsafe-huffman,unsafe-huffman-codebook,unsafe-match-table,unsafe-match-chain,unsafe-dictionary,unsafe-training'
HISTORY='encode::tests::search_history_tiny_horizons_wrap_across_width_eight_flush_tails'
DICTIONARY='encode::tests::search_history_dictionary_only_matches_survive_frame_zero_eviction'
SETTER='stream_encode::tests::search_and_frame_setters_are_order_independent_and_keep_selected_handles'
RESET='stream_encode::tests::search_session_resets_preserve_settings_and_parameter_resets_restore_defaults'

def sha(data): return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def files(root):
    return {str(p.relative_to(root)):{'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(p.read_bytes())}
            for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}

def main():
    if SNAPSHOT.exists() or PROBE.exists(): raise RuntimeError('Refusing to overwrite snapshot/probe')
    archive=subprocess.check_output(['git','archive','--format=tar',REV],cwd=ROOT)
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as tf:
        for member in tf.getmembers():
            p=Path(member.name)
            if p.is_absolute() or '..' in p.parts or not(member.isdir() or member.isfile()):
                raise RuntimeError('Unexpected archive entry: '+member.name)
    SNAPSHOT.mkdir()
    subprocess.run(['tar','-xf','-','-C',str(SNAPSHOT)],input=archive,check=True)
    before=files(SNAPSHOT)
    MANIFEST.write_text(json.dumps({'commit':REV,'snapshot':str(SNAPSHOT),'files':before},indent=2)+'\n')
    (PROBE/'src').mkdir(parents=True)
    (PROBE/'src/lib.rs').write_bytes(PROBE_SOURCE.read_bytes())
    (PROBE/'Cargo.toml').write_text('[package]\nname = "zstdoxide-module11-thumb-probe"\nversion = "0.0.0"\nedition = "2024"\n[dependencies]\nzstdoxide = { path = "'+str(SNAPSHOT)+'", default-features = false }\n')
    e={'schema':1,'commit':REV,'snapshot':str(SNAPSHOT),'git_archive_sha256':sha(archive),
       'manifest':{'path':str(MANIFEST),'sha256':sha(MANIFEST.read_bytes()),'file_count':len(before)},
       'scope':'Only approved bounded history/public interpretation checks and thumb compile-only library/caller checks; no repeated storage or maximum-shape tests.',
       'qualification':'Miri interprets Rust MIR for i686 (32-bit little-endian) and s390x (64-bit big-endian), not native or QEMU execution. Thumbv6m checks library compilation/caller rlib code generation on 32-bit little-endian without pointer atomics, with no runtime, firmware image, hardware allocator, memory-fit, or performance claim.',
       'bounded_review':'Tiny history uses hash10/chain10, key8, horizons1/2/7/8 and window10. Dictionary-only test uses horizon1 and at most1024-byte padding. Reset test uses hash10/chain10/history1024 and a23-byte input; only its first frame retains default window17 staging bound, then window10. Setter-order test does not process input.',
       'runner':{'path':__file__,'sha256':sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes())},
       'probe':{'root_source':str(PROBE_SOURCE),'root_source_sha256':sha(PROBE_SOURCE.read_bytes()),'path':str(PROBE),
                'source':(PROBE/'src/lib.rs').read_text(),'cargo':(PROBE/'Cargo.toml').read_text()},
       'commands':[],'metadata_commands':[],'completed':False}
    common={'CARGO_TERM_COLOR':'never','RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN':'nightly-2026-10-08'}
    def save():OUT.write_text(json.dumps(e,indent=2)+'\n')
    def run(name,command,cwd,fields,expected=None,metadata=False):
        env=os.environ.copy();env.pop('MIRI_SYSROOT',None);env.pop('MIRIFLAGS',None);env.update(common);env.update(fields)
        log=Path(BASE+'-'+name+'.log');start=time.monotonic();print('START '+name,flush=True)
        with log.open('wb') as h:r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=h,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        elapsed=time.monotonic()-start;data=log.read_bytes();text=data.decode(errors='replace')
        sums=[dict(zip(('passed','failed','ignored','measured','filtered_out'),map(int,row)))
              for row in re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored; (\d+) measured; (\d+) filtered out;',text)]
        passed=sum(x['passed'] for x in sums);ignored=sum(x['ignored'] for x in sums)
        valid=r.returncode==0 and(expected is None or(passed==expected and ignored==0 and f'Verified {expected} passing Miri test(s)' in text))
        rec={'name':name,'command':command,'cwd':str(cwd),'environment':{**common,**fields},'exit_code':r.returncode,'seconds':round(elapsed,4),'summaries':sums,'expected_passed':expected,'expected_count_guard':valid,'log':str(log),'log_sha256':sha(data),'log_bytes':len(data)}
        e['metadata_commands' if metadata else 'commands'].append(rec);save()
        print(f'END {name} exit={r.returncode} passed={passed} guard={valid}',flush=True)
        if not valid:raise RuntimeError('Command/count failed: '+name)
        return text
    save()
    e['compiler']=run('compiler',['rustc','+nightly-2026-10-08','-vV'],SNAPSHOT,{},metadata=True)
    for target in ['i686-unknown-linux-gnu','s390x-unknown-linux-gnu','thumbv6m-none-eabi']:
        e.setdefault('target_cfg',{})[target]=run('cfg-'+target,['rustc','+nightly-2026-10-08','--print','cfg','--target',target],SNAPSHOT,{},metadata=True)
    run('probe-lock',['cargo','+nightly-2026-10-08','generate-lockfile','--offline'],PROBE,{'CARGO_TARGET_DIR':'/tmp/zstdoxide-module11-platform-thumb-target'},metadata=True)
    probe_before=files(PROBE);e['probe']['files']=probe_before;save()
    for name,target,sysroot,flags,selectors in [
        ('miri-i686-safe','i686-unknown-linux-gnu','i686',[],[HISTORY,DICTIONARY,SETTER]),
        ('miri-i686-all','i686-unknown-linux-gnu','i686',['--all-features'],[HISTORY,DICTIONARY,SETTER]),
        ('miri-s390x-all','s390x-unknown-linux-gnu','s390x',['--all-features'],[HISTORY,RESET]),
    ]:
        fields={'MIRI_SYSROOT':'/tmp/zstdoxide-platform-sysroot-'+sysroot,'MIRIFLAGS':'-Zmiri-strict-provenance',
                'CARGO_TARGET_DIR':'/tmp/zstdoxide-module11-final-miri-'+sysroot}
        command=['python3','scripts/check_miri_filter.py','--offline','--locked','--target',target,'--lib',*flags,'--','--exact',*selectors,'--test-threads=1']
        run(name,command,SNAPSHOT,fields,len(selectors))
    thumb_env={'CARGO_TARGET_DIR':'/tmp/zstdoxide-module11-platform-thumb-target'}
    for name,flags in [('safe',[]),('all',['--features',FEATURES])]:
        run('thumb-library-'+name,['cargo','+nightly-2026-10-08','check','--offline','--locked','-Z','build-std=core,alloc','--target','thumbv6m-none-eabi','--no-default-features','--lib',*flags],SNAPSHOT,thumb_env)
    for name,flags in [('safe',[]),('all',['--features',','.join('zstdoxide/'+f for f in FEATURES.split(','))])]:
        run('thumb-probe-'+name,['cargo','+nightly-2026-10-08','build','--offline','--locked','-Z','build-std=core,alloc','--target','thumbv6m-none-eabi','--lib',*flags],PROBE,thumb_env)
        artifact=Path(thumb_env['CARGO_TARGET_DIR'])/'thumbv6m-none-eabi/debug/libzstdoxide_module11_thumb_probe.rlib'
        if not artifact.is_file():raise RuntimeError('Caller rlib missing')
        e.setdefault('caller_artifacts',{})[name]={'path':str(artifact),'bytes':artifact.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(artifact.read_bytes())};save()
    after=files(SNAPSHOT);probe_after=files(PROBE)
    e['source_unchanged']=after==before;e['changed_source_files']=[p for p in sorted(set(before)|set(after)) if before.get(p)!=after.get(p)]
    e['probe_unchanged']=probe_after==probe_before;e['root_probe_unchanged']=sha(PROBE_SOURCE.read_bytes())==e['probe']['root_source_sha256']
    e['passed']=sum(x['passed'] for c in e['commands'] for x in c['summaries']);e['completed']=e['source_unchanged'] and e['probe_unchanged'] and e['root_probe_unchanged'];save()
    if not e['completed']:raise RuntimeError('Source/probe content changed')
    print('EVIDENCE '+str(OUT)+' sha256='+sha(OUT.read_bytes()),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
